title.value: Interacting brains revisited: A cross-brain network neuroscience perspective
title.justification: This is the title of the paper.
title.quote: Interacting brains revisited: A cross-brain network neuroscience perspective

extractions.description: The study introduces a bipartite graph-based framework for analyzing interbrain networks, exploring neural synchrony during social interactions. It uses fNIRS hyperscanning data to investigate brain activity during cooperative and competitive tasks, demonstrating the potential of graph representations for predicting social characteristics and identifying biomarkers for social interaction and disorders.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper focuses on neuroscience and social interaction, not directly addressing sustainable development.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: Elucidating the neural basis of social behavior is a long-standing challenge in neuroscience. Such endeavors are driven by attempts to extend the isolated perspective on the human brain by considering interacting persons' brain activities, but a theoretical and computational framework for this purpose is still in its infancy.
